title: Four bit tricks
description:
Flags pack several on/off switches into one number. Write the four standard operations. `bit` is the position, counting from 0 at the right-hand end.

| Function | Does | Recipe |
|---|---|---|
| `setBit(flags, bit)` | switches the bit on | OR with the mask |
| `clearBit(flags, bit)` | switches it off | AND with the inverted mask |
| `toggleBit(flags, bit)` | flips it | XOR with the mask |
| `testBit(flags, bit)` | is it on? | AND with the mask, compare with 0 |

The mask for a bit is `1u << bit`. The first three return `unsigned int`; `testBit` returns `bool`.
hints: `~` flips every bit of the mask, so `flags & ~mask` keeps everything except that one bit.
